text.en:
Carer's Allowance. There is hereby granted a Carer's Allowance
of Five Hundred Seventy Five Pesos (P575.00) each to EC and EC PTD pensioners in
the public sector, Provided, That the actuarial stability of the GSIS-managed State
Insurance Fund shall be guaranteed, and Provided, Further, That such grant shall not
require increases in contributions.
Office of the President of the 39hiopines

Appropriation and Release from the SIF. The ECC and the
GSIS are hereby directed to appropriate and release the amount necessary to cover
the Carer's Allowance herein granted from the reserves of the State Insurance Fund
that the SIS administers for the public sector under the Employees' Compensation

Implementing Rules and Regulations. The ECC shall issue such
rules and regulations as may be necessary to implement this Executive Order.

Amendment or Modification. All Presidential issuances, rules
and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby amended or modified accordingly.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Executive Order is
declared invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall
remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect fifteen days
after its publication in the Official Gazette and in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 23rd day ofApril _ in the year of Our Lord,
two thousand and thirteen.
